items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did one recording session with her, with Benny Carter doing the arrangements.

ctx.x: . . . and they bought an apartment [house] uptown in Harlem, up on 154th, 155th Street. He took over everything, to try to run everything. So we just couldn’t see it eye to eye. In fact we did one – I did one recording session with her, with Benny Carter doing the arrangements. Benny Carter had to have me go in, because he kept interfering. Benny said, “If you don’t get this guy out of the studio while I’m doing this thing with her,” he said, “I’m going to break his neck.” Benny Carter meant exactly that. Benny…
She was represented by someone else?
